content:
**Highway 63** is a roadway in *Fallout 76*.

The roadway crosses the Appalachian region, having served as thoroughfare in West Virginia before the Great War.

Marked north to south. Behinds south of Fort Atlas, traversing southbound past Top of the World before merging with Highway 62 before reaching the Whitespring.

Highway 63 appears in *Fallout 76*.
